svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.estonia-flag-layout-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One introduced Estonia national-flag layout: three equal horizontal bands, blue/black/white from top to bottom, height:length 7:11. Frame [165, 105]mm on [205, 145]mm page. Boundaries convey equal regions;colour andidentity depend on the external key. Accessible teacher/audio key introduces estonia,orientation horizontal top to bottom,colour roles blue, black, white.
